rows.notes: Submission guard stays as one indexed user/workspace/project authorization query before or inside the D1 insert path.
Admin review queue uses the status/created-at index and keeps non-admin filtering in the server-side D1 repository.
Status update guard checks platform-admin authority and target existence before the transactional update/audit write.

d1RewriteStrategy.typeStrategy: Custom typed repository models mirror src/lib/workshop/beta-feedback.ts enum unions and SQLite CHECK constraints until a broader D1 type-generation strategy is selected.
preparedStatementPatterns: INSERT INTO beta_feedback_submissions (...) SELECT ... FROM users actor WHERE actor.id = ? AND lower(actor.email) = lower(?) AND EXISTS (...)
SELECT ... FROM beta_feedback_submissions WHERE status = ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users actor WHERE actor.id = ? AND actor.role IN ('admin', 'ceo')) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?
UPDATE beta_feedback_submissions SET status = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users actor WHERE actor.id = ? AND actor.role IN ('admin', 'ceo'))
INSERT INTO beta_feedback_status_events (...) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(feedback_id, status) DO NOTHING

note: Local-only D1 beta-feedback domain proof. It uses sanitized temporary SQLite tables to model the current protected feedback submission, forged-context denial, platform-admin review queue, admin-only status update, rollback, idempotency, query-budget, index-plan, and export/restore behavior. It does not read env files, call provider APIs, create hosted D1 databases, deploy Workers, replace Supabase-backed live Server Actions, change DNS, bill, or make production D1/Auth/Realtime ready.
